_doc: Unescaped values tools/html_sinks.py may let into markup, each read by a person. Key: 'scope::text' (scope = the innermost named function, or top), 'fn:NAME' (every return of NAME accepted), 'param:FN.NAME'. The value says why no model, world or player text can be in it. A key that matches nothing fails the guard, so this list cannot outlive the code it describes.
